questions.q: In Studio's Create Application File > Table dialog, which field actually implements Lesson 24's extend-task-or-stand-alone decision?
options: Label
Extends
Name
Accessible from
questions.explain: Extends is set to task to inherit state, assignment_group, and priority, or left blank for a standalone table — that single field is the whole decision.

questions.q: When creating the room field on Room Booking, what Type and Reference settings make it store a sys_id while displaying a readable room name?
options: Type: String, Reference: none
Type: Reference, Reference: the Room table
Type: Choice, Reference: the Room table
Type: Journal, Reference: none
questions.explain: A Reference-type field with its Reference set to the target table is exactly what stores a sys_id underneath a readable display value.

questions.q: What does List Layout actually configure for a new table like Room Booking?
options: Which fields appear as columns when the table is viewed as a list
Which users are allowed to delete records on that table
Whether the table extends task or stands alone
The order that fields are added to the dictionary
questions.explain: List Layout chooses the columns shown in list view, the same configuration step Course 2's Forms & Lists chapter covered.

questions.q: Room Booking has been fully built — dictionary fields, Form Layout, and List Layout are all configured. Why does it still have no entry in the Application Navigator?
options: The table was built in the wrong scope
The navigator displays modules, not tables directly, and no module yet points at Room Booking
Form Layout was not saved correctly
Tables that extend task are hidden from the navigator by default
questions.explain: The Application Navigator shows modules. A table with zero modules pointing at it has no entry in the tree, no matter how complete the table itself is.

questions.q: What does creating a Module record with Link type set to "List of Records", pointed at Room Booking, actually change about the table?
options: It changes the table's Extends field to task
It adds a new dictionary entry to the table
It makes the table's list view reachable as a clickable item in the Application Navigator, without changing the table itself
It deletes the direct-navigation shortcut for that table
questions.explain: The Module record only changes reachability in the navigator — the underlying table, its fields, and its layouts are untouched.
